name: pokepacker
description: 1. Copy `server/.env.example` to `server/.env` 2. Fill in your own database password 3. Create Database `psql -U postgres` 4. 'CREATE DATABASE pokepacker' 5. Create the tables: `psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d pokepacker -f server/src/db/schema.sql` 6. Insert sample data: `psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d pokepacker -f server/src/db/test_data.sql` 7. `npm install` then `npm run dev`
